parameters.query:
-- Where to tell the outside watcher (Healthchecks.io). Only a hc-ping.com address counts, so a wrong setting means
-- silence (and an email from the watcher), never data sent somewhere else. The test copy has no address: no ping.
-- Also the parts that are down right now (2 failed checks in a row), read after this run's report: the watcher hears
-- "failing" for those only, so a single blip doesn't email either.
select s.value as ping_url,
       coalesce((select string_agg(m.part || ': ' || coalesce(m.detail, ''), '; ' order by m.part)
                 from monitor_state m where m.down_since is not null), '') as down_parts
from system_settings s
where s.name = 'healthchecks_ping_url' and s.value ~ '^https://hc-ping[.]com/[A-Za-z0-9_/-]+$';

parameters.content: Every 5 minutes: checks the agent, the public address (tunnel) and OpenAI (a one-word embedding, a tiny real AI call, so a spending limit shows here). Posts to #support-alerts only when a part goes down or comes back. All well: tells Healthchecks.io; if those signals stop (PC, Docker or n8n down), it emails the owner. The /webhook/health address only answers, for the tunnel check.
